raw: [name="Fionn"]It's alright, I'm sure they're fine. I'll help you find that Messenger, come then.
speaker: Fionn
content: It's alright, I'm sure they're fine. I'll help you find that Messenger, come then.

speaker: Taran Refugee
content: Grand.

raw: [name="Taran Refugee"]...But where are we going? We chased a Dublinn squad that was all dead people, and Selmon's not found her own. Where should we head now?
speaker: Taran Refugee
content: ...But where are we going? We chased a Dublinn squad that was all dead people, and Selmon's not found her own. Where should we head now?

speaker: Fionn
content: *sigh* Reed, what do you...

speaker: Fionn
content: ...Reed? Where'd she go?

raw: [name="Selmon"]...Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen... three less than in the day.
speaker: Selmon
content: ...Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen... three less than in the day.

raw: [name="Selmon"]...I just don't get it. What kind of Originium Arts is this? Makes me sick looking at it.
speaker: Selmon
content: ...I just don't get it. What kind of Originium Arts is this? Makes me sick looking at it.

raw: She squats behind a boulder, looking around.
content: She squats behind a boulder, looking around.

raw: The soldiers keep marching for their heart's destination, upon the twilight wilds.
content: The soldiers keep marching for their heart's destination, upon the twilight wilds.

raw: The colors of the Dublinn uniform fade beneath layers of mud and soil. They seem as if held in a silhouette, one lit by a glimmer from somewhere unknown.
content: The colors of the Dublinn uniform fade beneath layers of mud and soil. They seem as if held in a silhouette, one lit by a glimmer from somewhere unknown.

raw: [name="Selmon"]I just need to... pounce, then retreat, and I'll be fine.
speaker: Selmon
content: I just need to... pounce, then retreat, and I'll be fine.
A hundred meters.

raw: They turn to walk straight for the boulder Selmon hides behind.
content: They turn to walk straight for the boulder Selmon hides behind.

raw: [name="Selmon"]Tch, he's at the back of the squad. Looks like he didn't get to be the leader. Made himself out so bloody big in all his letters.
speaker: Selmon
content: Tch, he's at the back of the squad. Looks like he didn't get to be the leader. Made himself out so bloody big in all his letters.

raw: [name="Selmon"]They're headed for... yeah, same direction as the letters said.
speaker: Selmon
content: They're headed for... yeah, same direction as the letters said.
Fifty meters.

raw: Selmon clenches the wooden cudgel in her fist.
content: Selmon clenches the wooden cudgel in her fist.

raw: [name="Selmon"]...Is the city you're heading for that important to you?
speaker: Selmon
content: ...Is the city you're heading for that important to you?

raw: [name="Selmon"]Who's telling you to head on? You'd still go, even if you died?
speaker: Selmon
content: Who's telling you to head on? You'd still go, even if you died?

raw: [name="Selmon"]Even though you're being battered by—wind, and rain, and all these people one after another? You'd still go?
speaker: Selmon
content: Even though you're being battered by—wind, and rain, and all these people one after another? You'd still go?
Thirty meters.

raw: She remembers the first time she saw Dublinn's troops, two years ago.
content: She remembers the first time she saw Dublinn's troops, two years ago.

raw: They told her, once she was decided, she could come to them. The Leader would give all Tarans a place to survive.
content: They told her, once she was decided, she could come to them. The Leader would give all Tarans a place to survive.

speaker: Selmon
content: ...I'm sorry.

raw: [name="Selmon"]I... never could be as sure as you were. You never looked back, but I did.
speaker: Selmon
content: I... never could be as sure as you were. You never looked back, but I did.
She rushes out.

raw: Like those Victorian soldiers in the daytime did, like Ch'en did, these people that have ceased to be can be knocked down again, so long as every attack comes swiftly enough, ferociously enough.
content: Like those Victorian soldiers in the daytime did, like Ch'en did, these people that have ceased to be can be knocked down again, so long as every attack comes swiftly enough, ferociously enough.

raw: Until they'll sleep peacefully in the soil of Tara, never called to stand again.
content: Until they'll sleep peacefully in the soil of Tara, never called to stand again.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.8, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: The soldier does not fall.

raw: He merely stumbles for a moment from the blow to the neck, and then swiftly spins around, pulling out his sword.
content: He merely stumbles for a moment from the blow to the neck, and then swiftly spins around, pulling out his sword.
He is ghastly silent.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Selmon"]You lot! Out of my way! I'll send you all right back with him!
speaker: Selmon
content: You lot! Out of my way! I'll send you all right back with him!

speaker: Selmon
content: No, I will, I'll do it!

raw: [name="Selmon"]I was just here to find my brother, but you're all the same...
speaker: Selmon
content: I was just here to find my brother, but you're all the same...

speaker: Dublinn Soldier
content: (Silently attacks)

raw: [name="Selmon"]—Piss right off! At least say something!
speaker: Selmon
content: —Piss right off! At least say something!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.7, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Selmon
content: Grgh...

speaker: Selmon
content: Square, that was...

raw: [name="Selmon"]Hah, bloody hell. Head, chest, it's just not enough, is it.
speaker: Selmon
content: Hah, bloody hell. Head, chest, it's just not enough, is it.

raw: Her cudgel flies out of her hand blocking the next attack.
content: Her cudgel flies out of her hand blocking the next attack.

raw: And in that moment, the soldier's mask falls off.
content: And in that moment, the soldier's mask falls off.

raw: She feels a sort of illusion for a moment. As if the way he brandishes his weapon slows, for a fraction of an instant.
content: She feels a sort of illusion for a moment. As if the way he brandishes his weapon slows, for a fraction of an instant.

raw: As if her brother is about to give him both his hands, like when Victoria's police accosted them in younger times, shielding her in his embrace.
content: As if her brother is about to give him both his hands, like when Victoria's police accosted them in younger times, shielding her in his embrace.

raw: And then she sees his familiar face all so clearly.
content: And then she sees his familiar face all so clearly.

raw: His forehead drips no blood, and his eyes turn no look to his little sister.
content: His forehead drips no blood, and his eyes turn no look to his little sister.

raw: Those eyes gaze to the distant, vague horizon, a rage of firelight longing, burning within.
content: Those eyes gaze to the distant, vague horizon, a rage of firelight longing, burning within.

raw: —Just like the night he decided he'd seek out Dublinn.
content: —Just like the night he decided he'd seek out Dublinn.

raw: And Dublinn soldiers surround them. Selmon blankly, dazedly, reaches a hand out to the man before her.
content: And Dublinn soldiers surround them. Selmon blankly, dazedly, reaches a hand out to the man before her.
Admiration, aspiration, guilt. Regret.

raw: All swallowed up by the ice-cold fire that her fingertips brush.
content: All swallowed up by the ice-cold fire that her fingertips brush.
Fear.

raw: All she is left with is fear. The fear of that longing, maniacal, burning unto death.
content: All she is left with is fear. The fear of that longing, maniacal, burning unto death.

raw: And before time can move again, flames blaze high, incandescent sparks blossoming into the night sky.
content: And before time can move again, flames blaze high, incandescent sparks blossoming into the night sky.

raw: So close her fingers could almost touch, a flame blooms forth, and vanishes again before she can grasp it. The soldier falls over, to the ground, and never makes another whisper.
content: So close her fingers could almost touch, a flame blooms forth, and vanishes again before she can grasp it. The soldier falls over, to the ground, and never makes another whisper.
